goal.objective: Expand canonical heartbeat, subsignal, worker readiness, and task-registry state across every StegVerse organization while preserving fail-closed blockers and authority separation.
success_predicates: All 14 canonical organizations are represented in the federation registry.
Every organization has heartbeat response, subsignal, worker-readiness, task-registry, evidence-owner, and next-action state.
Every unresolved organization has a machine-observable release condition.
The organization_federation subsignal is carried by the single StegVerse heartbeat.
A heartbeat-owned worker is claimed, fenced, executed, and produces an inspectable federation receipt.
failure_predicates: An organization disappears from the denominator without an admitted inventory transition.
A blocked organization is treated as complete without its release condition becoming true.
Transport or subsignal presence grants execution or policy authority.
A second heartbeat or wall-clock scheduler becomes federation authority.
Worker capability matching is treated as authorization.

task.derivation_reason: User directed expansion of the proven heartbeat/subsignal/worker/task-registry readiness model from StegVerse-Labs to all organizations.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while any organization readiness state is blocked or changed

completion.next_authorized_action: Continue only through the existing machine-owned federation worker/runtime lane: on an eligible StegVerse runtime, emit/evaluate fresh manifests for the admitted critical denominator and persist the canonical coverage receipt. The standalone hosted validation workflow is retired; stable-dispatcher validation does not satisfy live coverage.
terminal_when: Every blocked organization has an explicit release condition and next action
